best_idea: Express each rank as a number of equal-cost kills (the threshold is a multiple of the unit's own cost, so one data row sets how many fights a rank takes), with the per-rank multipliers as data rows.
decision_why: Keep the cost-scaled thresholds and the per-rank data rows; use server-verified kills and one ledger; fix the donor's unsorted thresholds and the int truncation that zeroes small hits. GPL-3.0: shape only.
acceptance: Five kills with an equal-cost unit give the veteran badge and a rank-up line on the fight record; a server test asserts rank 1 at 500 x cost XP, XP clamped at the top threshold, and elite damage taken at 75 percent of raw.
